**Multiple Refiners Don't Persist in Save/Load**: Fixed critical bug where refiners weren't saved/loaded correctly - **Root Cause 1**: RefinerStructure was `@dataclass(frozen=True)` since HOTFIX 3, but `_register_refiner_on_grid()` requires mutations (`grid_cell`, `grid_cells`, `position`) - **Root Cause 2**: FrozenInstanceError on second+ refiner placement prevented grid registration and save - **Impact**: Players lost all refiners after reload (only worked if exactly 1 refiner placed) - **Fix**: Removed `frozen=True` from RefinerStructure - it's mutable but mutations only during controlled grid registration

**Leaderboard Button Not Responsive**: Fixed leaderboard button in options menu doing nothing - **Root Cause**: Code referenced `self.leaderboard_window` which doesn't exist; correct object is `self.leaderboard_system` - **Impact**: Clicking leaderboard button had no effect - **Fix**: Changed `self.leaderboard_window.toggle()` to `self.leaderboard_system.toggle()` (line 2891)
`src/game_manager.py`: - Line 2891: Fixed leaderboard button click handler to use correct leaderboard_system instance

**RefinerStructure Unhashable Error**: Fixed `unhashable type: 'RefinerStructure'` TypeError - **Root Cause**: RefinerStructure was used in sets/dicts (spatial grid, tooltip caching) but wasn't hashable - **Impact**: Game would crash repeatedly when refiner tooltips were rendered - **Fix**: Made RefinerStructure immutable with `@dataclass(frozen=True)` - Frozen dataclasses are automatically hashable (assuming all fields are hashable) - Maintains backward compatibility (only prevents in-place field mutations)
`src/refiner_structure.py`: - Added `frozen=True` to @dataclass decorator (line 10) - RefinerStructure now hashable for use in spatial grids and sets

**Double Tooltip in Store Menu**: Fixed multiple overlapping tooltips appearing in shopping menu - **Root Cause**: Three separate tooltip rendering systems were active simultaneously: 1. `accordion_menu` - draws upgrade_card tooltips 2. `self.tooltip` (UpgradeTooltip) - draws additional tooltip 3. `self.interactive_tooltips` - draws entity tooltips - **Impact**: Confusing visual overlap with 2+ tooltips at same position - **Fix**: Disable `self.tooltip` rendering when store menu is open (`not self.in_store`)
`src/game_manager.py`: - Line 2177: Added `and not self.in_store` condition to tooltip rendering - Comment updated to clarify tooltip system separation in store menu

**HUD GUI Instance Initialization Bug**: Fixed `AttributeError: 'GameManager' object has no attribute 'hud_gui_instance'` - **Root Cause**: `hud_gui_instance` was being used in `draw()` before being initialized in `__init__()` - **Impact**: Game would crash when trying to draw collector/hauler buttons on first frame - **Fix**: Initialize `self.hud_gui_instance = None` in `__init__()` to ensure attribute exists before first draw - **Additional Fixes**: Replaced all incorrect references to `self.modern_gui_instance` with `self.hud_gui_instance`

**Feature**: Intelligent warrior selection prioritizes unbuffed warriors - **Primary**: Unbuffed warriors (no active buffs) - always buffed first - **Secondary**: Least-buffed warriors (fewest buffs) when all warriors have buffs - **Tertiary**: Distance sorting - closest warriors prioritized within priority groups

**Logic**: `_update_buff_targets()` separates warriors into unbuffed/buffed lists - Unbuffed list sorted by distance (closest first) - Buffed list sorted by (buff_count, distance) - least buffed & closest - Priority list = unbuffed + buffed - Select first `max_targets` warriors from priority list
**Result**: - Buffers no longer "waste" buffs on already-buffed warriors ✅ - Better distribution of buffs across all warriors ✅ - Multiple buffers naturally spread out to cover more warriors ✅

**Feature**: Buffers always buff nearest warriors, never locked onto one target - Continuous re-evaluation every 0.5s scan cycle - Clears current buffed list and re-applies buffs based on current positions - No "sticky" behavior - if warrior moves away, buffer switches to closer warrior

**Implementation**: `_update_buff_targets()` clears buffed_warriors and rebuilds - Removes old buffs from warriors: `_remove_buff_from_warrior()` - Clears buffed list: `buffed_warriors.clear()` - Finds new targets based on current positions - Applies new buffs to selected warriors
**Result**: - Buffers adapt to warrior movement in real-time ✅ - No wasted buffs on distant warriors ✅ - Fluid, reactive buff coverage ✅

**Feature**: Soft constraint prevents buffers/warriors from stacking on same grid cell - **Grid size**: 50px = 1 grid cell (matches game grid) - **Mechanism**: When moving towards warrior, check if target grid cell occupied - **Fallback**: Try 8 adjacent cells in spiral pattern (E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE) - **Soft constraint**: If all adjacent cells occupied, buffer can still stack (not a hard stop)

**Implementation**: Added three helper methods - `_world_to_grid(world_pos)` - Convert world coordinates to grid cell (x, y) - `_grid_to_world(grid_cell)` - Convert grid cell to world position (center of cell) - `_is_grid_occupied(grid_cell)` - Check if grid cell has another buffer or warrior - `_calculate_anti_stacking_position(target_pos, desired_distance)` - Find free adjacent cell
**Integration**: `_move_towards()` calls `_calculate_anti_stacking_position()` before movement
**Result**: - Buffers visually spread out around warriors ✅ - Less visual clutter - distinct unit positions ✅ - Improved game aesthetics ✅

Buff calculation logic was REVERSED in update_multipliers() - Was using `multiplier *= bonus_value` (wrong: 0.05 becomes 0.05x damage) - Should use `multiplier = 1.0 + bonus_value` (correct: 0.05 becomes 1.05x damage) - **Fix Applied**: 1. Added `update_multipliers()` call in ProgressionSystemIntegration.__init__() - ensures initialization 2. Added `update_multipliers()` call after ProgressionSystemIntegration.load() - ensures loaded games have correct multipliers 3. Fixed buff_application.py update_multipliers() logic to correctly apply relative bonuses 4. Fixed progression_integration.py get_buff_value() to convert relative bonuses to absolute multipliers 5. Reverted default parameter in skill_tree_manager.py get_buff_value() to 0 (correct default for relative bonus)
